newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $2.4 bln for next week.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $2.4 bln for next week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for the week of April 28 are expected to total $2.4 billion in 88 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $2 billion in 37 sales, with a $640 million NYC Municipal Water Agency deal through J.P. Morgan Securities Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 51 sales totaling $453 million are on the schedule. A $115 million Montgomery County, Md., deal on Tuesday is the largest.
An additional 11 sales totaling $570 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds next week , depending on market conditions.
